channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: K, C or E? Why economists can’t agree on the shape of today’s economy
item.description: Economists have long viewed the post-pandemic economy as "K"-shaped. That consensus has now evaporated.

item.title: OpenAI to end model access to Cursor after acquisition by Elon Musk's SpaceX
item.description: OpenAI plans to end model access through Cursor on Nov. 12, citing concerns after SpaceX’s $60 billion acquisition of the coding startup.

item.title: Tech backlash reaches fever pitch as AI angst collides with social media fears
item.description: With data center concerns becoming a major election issue and Meta reaching a landmark settlement in a social media case, the tech backlash is gaining steam.

item.title: Trump announces deal with Venezuela to secure more than 65 billion barrels of oil reserves
item.description: The U.S. struck a deal with Venezuela to get majority control of more than 65 billion barrels of oil reserves, Trump said in a social media post.

item.title: Iran trade falls as Supreme Leader Khamenei urges less reliance on the U.S. dollar
item.description: Iran's president says sanctions are hitting imports and exports, as its supreme leader urges less reliance on the U.S. dollar.

item.title: Bank of America says these stocks have upside heading into September
item.description: Several stocks offer plenty more room to appreciate in September, Bank of America said this week.

item.title: Trump administration weighs Yosemite land swap for private developer’s access road
item.description: The Trump administration is considering a Yosemite land exchange that could give a developer more direct park access.

item.title: The big lesson from this week's earnings: The AI buildout is not a zero-sum game
item.description: Salesforce, CrowdStrike, and Nvidia all faced major tests with investors and crushed expectations.

item.title: Meta’s $18 billion settlement puts TikTok and YouTube on notice. Who's next on the firing line?
item.description: "Meta is seeking to ensure its competitors will face the same rules," one business professor told CNBC after Meta called on rivals to protect children online.

item.title: Stocks eked out a winning week. Here are the names that are now overbought
item.description: Investors may have gotten overenthusiastic on a couple big names.

item.title: National Park Service backs Trump’s 250-foot arch despite ‘adverse effects’ on historic sites
item.description: The park service is backing the arch, despite finding that it would adversely affect historic sightlines and other visual relationships among nearby landmarks.

item.title: Nepal resumes flood rescue, seeks technical help and billions of dollars
item.description: The Himalayan nation called for specialist foreign assistance and its finance minister told Reuters it would also need up to $5 billion to rebuild.

item.title: S&P 500 falls Friday after Fed’s Warsh highlights inflation worries, but index posts positive week
item.description: The three major indexes posted winning weeks.

item.title: Op-ed: Salesforce just revealed the next battleground in AI — and it's not the models
item.description: For the past year, markets have vaporized roughly $2 trillion in software value by asking the wrong question about AI.

item.title: Goodyear burning rubber and cash as turnaround plan continues
item.description: The tire maker has an ongoing turnaround plan as the company tries to restructure its business, refinance and pay down years of debt.

item.title: Buffett remains active at 96, but Berkshire's shares aren't doing much
item.description: Warren Buffett will be celebrating his 96th birthday on Sunday, but Berkshire Hathaway investors aren't celebrating the stock's anemic performance.

item.title: CFTC fines former White House aide $172,000 for trading on Trump speech information
item.description: Perez ⁠had access to Trump's speeches before they were delivered and used that information to ‌trade the contracts for his personal benefit, the CFTC said.

item.title: Op-ed: Dolly Parton was underestimated for decades. That became one of her greatest strengths
item.description: In a candid 2015 interview, Dolly Parton told CNBC's Tania Bryer about depression, ambition and the business decisions that defined her career.

item.title: Next week will show how sustainable the AI trade is. Here's what's ahead, including a jobs report
item.description: Whether artificial intelligence can sustain its advance remains to be seen.

item.title: Russian strike on Kyiv-area ammunition depot triggers blast, killing 37
item.description: Ukraine President Volodymyr Zelenskyy vowed to punish suspected negligence in the second such incident in two months.

item.title: What we learned from Warsh's Jackson Hole speech, and GE Vernova's CFO to retire
item.description: Every weekday, the Investing Club releases the Homestretch; an actionable afternoon update just in time for the last hour of trading.

item.title: Massive new Delta card welcome offers: Earn up to 200,000 bonus miles or multiple flight certificates
item.description: Compared to previous offers, these Delta card bonuses are unusually valuable. Here's how to earn up to 200,000 bonus miles or multiple flight certificates.

item.title: Imax says it's open to a sale. Why is no one buying?
item.description: Imax's stock and box office are breaking records, but studio conflicts and a soaring valuation complicate the list of who could bid for the company.

item.title: Bessent attacks Warren over yen intervention query, offers ‘Foreign Exchange for Dummies’ lesson
item.description: Treasury has not disclosed how much yen it bought, the execution rate or the current value of the position, despite Warren’s requests for details.

item.title: Norway's King Haakon honors 'dear father' Harald in first speech as sovereign
item.description: Harald V died Friday morning and his 53-year-old son, Crown Prince Haakon, became King Haakon VIII.

item.title: Analysis: Kevin Warsh sharpens inflation warning at Jackson Hole, signaling possible rate hike
item.description: After confusing markets at his July news conference, Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh used Jackson Hole to give a clearer view of the case for higher interest rates.

item.title: We're in the midst of an 'Imax awakening,' CEO says. How the company makes millions
item.description: Christopher Nolan's "The Odyssey" has movie and history buffs flocking to theaters this summer. That's been great news for Imax.

item.title: Some U.S. cities have begun rewarding careful drivers with fewer red lights
item.description: Albuquerque and Portland, Oregon, have added speed sensors that grant a much earlier green light to drivers traveling at or below the posted limit.

item.title: Corn and wheat prices jump to highest prices in more than three years
item.description: Corn and wheat futures have surged to their highest levels in more than three years. But the reasons for these recent rallies are notably different.

item.title: Stock traders warm up to Warsh as volatility index touches year-to-date low
item.description: The Cboe Volatility Index (VIX), which measures the price of 30-day options on the S&P 500 Index, fell to as low as 14.1.
